video: SYNTHETIC — no source video. This is an INSTRUMENT CONTROL, not an extraction artifact.
_why: MATERIALITY-SIGNAL CONTROL (R-494 §4). Pre-registered in AR-507 §2 BEFORE this file existed.
IT LIVES OUTSIDE ci/fixtures/spec-binding-parity-expanded ON PURPOSE. That directory is the
declared efficacy population the materiality receipt MEASURES; adding a member there would
both trip the parity gate's membership check and contaminate the population being measured.
A CONTROL MUST NOT JOIN THE POPULATION IT LICENCES.
WHAT IT IS FOR: the materiality receipt's frozen failure criterion is 'A HIGHER compiled COUNT
IS A FAILURE SIGNAL'. AR-506 measured that all 12 efficacy specs already compile in BEFORE, so
a false->true transition is ARITHMETICALLY UNREACHABLE there and the signal could only ever
print PASS. R-494 §1 then found the deeper defect: the emitter exited 0 even when it printed
its own STOP banner. A DECLARED FAILURE SIGNAL THAT RETURNS SUCCESS IS NOT A GATE.
THE ARITHMETIC, so the composition can be checked rather than trusted:
spine = 3 rows. `enter` (ENTER) binds. `exc_a` and `exc_b` (EXCEPTION) do not.
spineBound / spine.length = 1/3 = 0.3333.
spec-family-bindings.ts:382 sets compiled=false iff spineRatio < MIN_SPINE_BOUND_RATIO.
0.3333 < 0.5  -> compiled = FALSE  ................ the NORMAL state, in BOTH lanes
0.3333 < 0.0  -> false, so compiled = TRUE ........ under the transient loosening
WHY `EXCEPTION` AND NOT AN ORPHAN ZONE — this is the load-bearing design choice:
EXCEPTION carries unsupported:true with control_flow_exception_unsupported in the BEFORE lane
(git show 926fe9a1~1) AND in the current lane, IDENTICALLY. The control is therefore built
entirely from behaviour that PREDATES the repair, so it moves for a reason the repair does not
own. An orphan-zone spine row would entangle the control with the very change it exists to
police. NEITHER LANE'S SEMANTICS ARE ALTERED TO PRODUCE THIS — doing so would be inventing
behaviour to satisfy a test (R-494 §4-6).

normal            BEFORE compiled=false -> AFTER compiled=false   receipt exit 0
MIN 0.5 -> 0.0    BEFORE compiled=false -> AFTER compiled=TRUE    receipt NAMES this control
and EXITS NON-ZERO
